text_description: Full runway look built from a matching sleeveless top and skirt in a muted beige ground with alternating vertical red and green stripes. The top is hip-length and slightly boxy, with a high round neckline, clean sleeveless armholes, and a striped border running horizontally around the hem; an asymmetric front placket sits to one side of the torso, edged in red and fastened with visible gold-tone buttons. Beneath it, the coordinating skirt starts at the waist/upper hip and falls to around the knee with a soft A-line, gathered, fluid shape; the same red and green vertical stripes continue down the skirt, interrupted by a front tie or narrow fabric belt detail and gentle pleats that create movement at the hem. Styling is bold and polished, with a large sculptural gold-tone collar necklace, dangling earrings, and a deep burgundy shoulder bag tucked under one arm. The footwear is bright green open-toe high-heeled sandals, adding a vivid color accent that echoes the green stripe. The overall mood is refined resort/runway dressing: graphic striped coordination, relaxed structure, and statement accessories.
